en: I'm just looking, thanks.
I'm looking for a white shirt.
Do you have this model in another size?
fr: Vous avez ce modèle dans une autre taille ?
zh: 这个款式有其他尺码吗？

en: What size am I?
This size is too small for me.
fr: Cette taille me va trop petit.

en: Could you bring me one size up?
fr: Vous pouvez m'apporter une taille au-dessus ?

en: It's loose on my back.
Can I try it on?
Where is the fitting room?
I'll try these trousers on.
It's tight at the waist.
fr: Ça me serre à la taille.

en: It fits me perfectly.
Does it suit me?
I don't like this colour.
Do you have it in dark blue?
This beige is too light.
I prefer the grey to the black.
fr: Je préfère le gris au noir.
zh: 比起黑色我更喜欢灰色。

en: Does the colour run in the wash?
How much does it cost?
Is it on offer?

pt: Qual é o preço com desconto?
en: What's the price with the discount?
fr: Quel est le prix avec la remise ?

en: It's expensive for the quality.
zh: 就这个质量来说太贵了。

en: I'll take this one, please.
fr: Je prends celui-ci, s'il vous plaît.

en: I'd like to pay by card.
Can I pay with MB Way?
fr: Je peux payer avec MB Way ?

en: I'll pay in cash.
Do you have change for twenty euros?
fr: Vous avez la monnaie pour vingt euros ?

pt: Queria um talão, se faz favor.
en: I'd like a receipt, please.
fr: Je voudrais un ticket, s'il vous plaît.

en: Could you gift-wrap it?

pt: Queria trocar isto por outro tamanho.
en: I'd like to exchange this for another size.
fr: Je voudrais échanger ceci contre une autre taille.

en: Can I return it if it doesn't fit?
fr: Je peux le rendre si ça ne va pas ?

pt: Qual é o prazo de troca?
en: How long do I have to exchange it?
I'd like a refund, please.
fr: Je voudrais un remboursement, s'il vous plaît.

pt: Aqui está o talão de compra.
en: Here's the receipt for the purchase.
The item is faulty.

pt: Falta um botão a esta camisa.
en: There's a button missing on this shirt.
fr: Il manque un bouton à cette chemise.
zh: 这件衬衫少了一颗扣子。

en: I'd like to speak to the manager.
Do you have this shoe in size 42?
These shoes are tight on me.
These heels are too high.
I need a small wallet.
Where are the accessories?

pt: A montra tinha um casaco bonito.
en: The window display had a lovely coat.
fr: La vitrine avait un joli manteau.
zh: 橱窗里有一件漂亮的大衣。

en: Are there more colours over there?
fr: Il y a d'autres couleurs là-bas ?

en: This fabric is very thin.
Is it made in Portugal?

pt: Queria dois: um para mim e outro para a minha irmã.
en: I'd like two: one for me and one for my sister.
fr: J'en voudrais deux : un pour moi et un pour ma sœur.
zh: 我要两个，一个给我，一个给我妹妹。

en: I'll think it over.
Could you keep this for me until tomorrow?
fr: Vous pouvez me le garder jusqu'à demain ?

en: Thank you very much, you've been very kind.
fr: Merci beaucoup, vous avez été très aimable.

en: Where is the post office?
fr: Où est le bureau de poste ?

pt: Queria enviar esta carta para a China.
en: I'd like to send this letter to China.
fr: Je voudrais envoyer cette lettre en Chine.
zh: 我想把这封信寄到中国。

pt: Quanto custa um selo para a França?
en: How much is a stamp to France?
fr: Combien coûte un timbre pour la France ?
zh: 寄到法国的邮票多少钱？

pt: Preciso de dois selos, por favor.
en: I need two stamps, please.
fr: Il me faut deux timbres, s'il vous plaît.

pt: Queria mandar isto por correio registado.
en: I'd like to send this by registered post.

pt: Pode pesar o pacote, por favor?
en: Could you weigh the parcel, please?
fr: Vous pouvez peser le colis, s'il vous plaît ?

en: Has a parcel arrived for me?
fr: Un colis est arrivé pour moi ?

en: I've come to collect a parcel.

pt: Aqui está o aviso dos correios.
en: Here's the notice from the post office.
How long does it take to arrive?
fr: Ça met combien de temps à arriver ?

pt: Onde há um multibanco aqui perto?
en: Is there a cash machine near here?
fr: Il y a un distributeur près d'ici ?

pt: O multibanco não aceita o meu cartão.
en: The cash machine won't take my card.
fr: Le distributeur n'accepte pas ma carte.

en: I'd like to withdraw some money.
I'd like to deposit this cheque.

pt: Queria abrir uma conta, se faz favor.
en: I'd like to open an account, please.
fr: Je voudrais ouvrir un compte, s'il vous plaît.

en: I need to make a transfer.
What's the fee?
Could you check my balance?
I've forgotten my card PIN.
fr: J'ai oublié le code de ma carte.

pt: O cartão ficou preso na máquina.
en: My card got stuck in the machine.
fr: Ma carte est restée coincée dans la machine.

pt: Queria marcar um corte de cabelo.
en: I'd like to book a haircut.
fr: Je voudrais prendre rendez-vous pour une coupe.

pt: Tem hora para amanhã à tarde?
en: Do you have a slot tomorrow afternoon?
fr: Vous avez un créneau demain après-midi ?

en: Just a cut, no wash.
Just trim the ends, please.
fr: Coupez juste les pointes, s'il vous plaît.

en: I don't want it too short.
fr: Je ne veux pas trop court.

en: Could you trim my beard as well?
fr: Vous pouvez tailler la barbe aussi ?

en: How much will it be?
I really like the result.
Where is there a launderette?
I'd like these shirts washed.
fr: Je voudrais faire laver ces chemises.

pt: Preciso de lavar a seco este casaco.
en: This coat needs dry-cleaning.
fr: Ce manteau doit être nettoyé à sec.

en: When will it be ready?
I need it by Friday.

pt: Pode passar a ferro estas calças?
en: Could you iron these trousers?
One of my shirts is missing.
This stain won't come out.

pt: A máquina de lavar está avariada.
en: The washing machine is broken.
fr: La machine à laver est en panne.

en: Can you repair this watch?
My phone won't charge.
The screen is cracked.
I'd like a quote first.
Is it worth repairing?
fr: Ça vaut la peine de le réparer ?

en: The warranty is still valid.
I left some shoes at the cobbler's.
fr: J'ai laissé des chaussures chez le cordonnier.

pt: Quando é que posso vir buscar?
en: When can I come and collect it?
fr: Quand est-ce que je peux venir le chercher ?

en: I'd like to book an appointment.

pt: Não posso ir, tenho de desmarcar.
en: I can't come, I have to cancel.
fr: Je ne peux pas venir, je dois annuler.

en: Could you move it to Monday?

pt: Vou chegar com uns minutos de atraso.
en: I'll be a few minutes late.
fr: Je vais avoir quelques minutes de retard.

en: Thank you very much for your help.
